description: Ministry of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage - Order to approve the acquisition of the immovable property in Diddenipotha North, Makandura D/S Division, Matara District for the constructions and Makandura Water Supply Project and properties in Nawinnapitiya, Galhinna, Deddeniya and Medagoda in Pujapitiya D/S Division, Kandy District for the constructions under Kandy North - Pathadumbara Integrated Water Supply Project
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act. It specifically describes the acquisition of immovable properties (land parcels) for water supply infrastructure projects, including detailed descriptions of the land boundaries, extents, locations, and claimants. While it mentions a government minister (Rauff Hakeem) and his ministerial title, this is incidental to the core land acquisition purpose, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities described beyond what is necessary for the land acquisition authority. The content fits squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registrations, acquisitions, and property descriptions.
